title: SEVENTH LEVEL SPELLS - the 12 seventh level shukenja spells with the school, component, casting time, saving throw, reversible and sohei codes
audit_label: R665 OA seventh level spells audit
audit_comment: OA round fifty-two (capture pp. 147-152): the seventh level spell stat blocks - the school, component, casting time and saving throw codes with the reversible and sohei-usable markers, cross-checked spell by spell between the passes

banner.title: SEVENTH LEVEL SPELLS, printed capture pp. 147-152 - the OA seventh level spells round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read - the 12 seventh level spell stat blocks cross-checked spell by spell between the passes (print pp. 147-152; compressed pp. 71-73); all 12 schools, component sets, casting times and saving throws agree, zero contested stat reads. The level closes the shukenja spell list: astral spell takes the three-turn cast (180 segments, the longest of the level), three spells a turn (divine wind, reincarnate, resurrection), five a round, quest eight segments, gate five, and holy (unholy) word casts in a single segment. Two spells take the negation save (compel, quest) and two the special (exaction, restore spirit - the system shock roll); no half saves this level. Conjuration/summoning and necromantic tie as the most common school at three spells each; exaction dual Evocation/Alteration pinned primary evocation per the dual-school convention (the abjure and aid precedent); no divination or illusion this level. Resurrection alone reads Reversible (the destruction reverse) - the single reversible mark matching the R658 T62 grid; holy (unholy) word carries no reversible marker in either pass despite its parenthetical name, and ancient curse alone is sohei-usable - the T62 grid settles both. One prose divergence noted outside the stat grid: compel's save penalty for the greater-than-150% bracket reads +4 in the print against -4 in the compressed - the print settles. The stat grid pins as a table: 12 rows the spell ordinals, six columns - school, components (a V=1 S=2 M=4 bitmask), casting time in segments (1 round = 10, 1 turn = 60, 3 turns = 180), saving throw code (0 none, 1 neg., 2 special, 3 half), reversible and sohei markers. The spell names ride the column comments, the prose descriptions close in their own rounds. The table tag L7Data identifier-safe per the R639 lesson
banner.sentinel: the gap census after this round: 118 closed, 117 open - the Seventh Level Spells box flips (census 587 -> 588); the shukenja spell chapter rounds are COMPLETE - NEXT - R666: the Table 63 Divination Results (capture p. 117, rides its own box), prefix to verify free, audit "R666 OA divination results audit"
